implementation_summary.preserved_primitives: gardener.py:SkillROILedger's existing net_tokens_saved/roi_ratio/success_rate/SkillHealth arithmetic and thresholds are byte-for-byte unchanged. record_usage() keeps its exact original positional signature and behavior (backward-compatible; the pre-existing synthetic test tests/test_p3_gaps_live_integration.py::test_skill_roi_ledger_and_gardener_audit still passes unmodified). No new scoring formula was invented.
implementation_summary.measured_vs_estimated: skill_roi_ledger gained nullable columns (skill_version, measurement_state, estimated_tokens_saved, estimate_evidence_ref, measured_evidence_ref, candidate_evaluation_ref). MeasurementState is an explicit three-value enum (measured / estimated_only / unavailable). 0 is stored and read only as a real measured value, never as a stand-in for missing data; get_summary()/list_all() filter to measurement_state='measured' rows only, so estimated_only/unavailable evidence never enters the existing arithmetic.
implementation_summary.composition_not_recomputation: SkillROILedger.record_from_evidence(home, skill_name) is the new composition entrypoint. Estimated: _estimated_benefit() reads state/radar/candidates.json expected_benefit_tokens via the P3.10 ImprovementRadar.get_candidate() API (handles both the legacy source_radar_candidate_id binding field and the current P3.12 source_type='radar'/source_ref schema). Measured: _measured_from_counterfactual_result() prefers the most recent CURRENT P3.13 counterfactual_result under outputs/audits/counterfactual/skill/, computed as without_arm.tokens.total - with_arm.tokens.total (savings from having the skill); _measured_from_evaluation() is the fallback to P3.11's evaluation.json roi.net_tokens_saved when no current P3.13 result exists. Neither token accounting nor counterfactual measurement is recomputed in gardener.py; both remain fully owned by credit.py/skillforge.py.
implementation_summary.version_binding: Every composed record binds skill_id + skill_version (skillforge.lifecycle_content_hash of the skill's CURRENT SKILL.md) + estimate_evidence_ref (radar:<candidate_id>) + measured_evidence_ref (counterfactual:<file> or evaluation:<evaluation_id>) + candidate_evaluation_ref (P3.11 candidate_id, when applicable). Stale evidence (evaluation/counterfactual bound to a different content hash) is rejected outright, never silently reused for a changed skill. A documented legacy-compatibility path also accepts the pre-P3.12 raw (non-lifecycle-normalized) content hash, since that scheme predates lifecycle_content_hash but represents identical, unchanged file bytes — real backward compatibility, not a fabricated pass.
implementation_summary.measured_vs_estimated_comparison: _classify_comparison() produces one of measured_negative / measured_approximately_zero / estimate_optimistic / estimate_accurate / estimate_pessimistic / inconclusive from real estimated_tokens_saved and measured_tokens_saved values, with estimation_error = measured - estimated. Never forces a positive result; a real negative or near-zero measurement is reported as such regardless of what was estimated.
implementation_summary.idempotency_fix: A first independent validator pass and this implementation's own live dogfood together surfaced a real correctness gap: calling record_from_evidence() twice against the same unchanged evidence inserted a duplicate ledger row, double-counting the measurement. Fixed with a (skill_name, skill_version, measured_evidence_ref, measurement_state) existence check before insert; repeated composition now returns the same record_id and never inflates get_summary()'s totals (tests/test_p3_14_skill_roi_evidence.py::test_record_from_evidence_is_idempotent_for_same_evidence).
implementation_summary.no_promotion_coupling: record_from_evidence()/audit_portfolio() make zero calls into promotion.py in either direction; no skill is auto-promoted or auto-retired. Confirmed both by code inspection and by the live dogfood (read-reuse's lifecycle level and skills/candidates/ contents were unchanged before/after; no new state/promotions/*.json record was written).
implementation_summary.sqlite_storage_decision: The frozen plan's only direct storage guidance (line 412) lists 'tool/skill ROI' as SQLite-appropriate data; the existing state/skills/skill_roi.sqlite ledger is kept as the frozen storage surface, per point 6 of this closure's instructions, but is now explicitly a DERIVED evidence store — every measured row points back to its canonical P3.10/P3.11/P3.13 evidence file/id via the new *_evidence_ref/*_ref columns rather than being an independent source of economic truth. No broader database migration was performed; db.py's canonical connection abstraction was not applicable here (SkillROILedger's existing dedicated file/schema was preserved unchanged rather than migrated, since no real production data existed before this session and no reproducible incompatibility with db.py's abstraction was found).
implementation_summary.cli_surface: Deliberately out of scope for this closure: the CLI gap flagged by the prior qualification was not named as a requirement in this closure's 12-point instruction set, so no cli.py subcommand was added. record_from_evidence()/get_summary()/audit_portfolio() remain reachable via direct Python import, matching this closure's explicit scope.
implementation_summary.regenerated_tests: New tests/test_p3_14_skill_roi_evidence.py (21 tests): full estimate+measurement composition, P3.13-preferred-over-P3.11 ordering, stale-evaluation rejection, legacy raw-hash compatibility, estimated-only exclusion from measured arithmetic, unavailable-when-nothing-exists, measured-zero validity, unknown-skill error, six classify_comparison variants (parametrized), get_summary row filtering, record_usage backward compatibility, no-promotion-coupling, gardener audit using composed evidence, and idempotency. tests/test_p3_gaps_live_integration.py's original synthetic test passes unmodified.
implementation_summary.full_suite: Full pytest suite (all files) passes with zero failures; ruff check/format and pyright clean on src and tests; Prime extension Vitest suite unaffected (Python-only change).

dogfood_evidence.read_reuse_full_chain: Real P3.10 estimate (expected_benefit_tokens=600, candidate-76c88737ad58a6a525c959f5) + real P3.11 measurement (roi.net_tokens_saved=-850, accepted via the legacy raw-hash compatibility path) -> measurement_state=measured, estimation_error=-1450, comparison=measured_negative (honest, matches P3.11's original HOLD verdict, not coerced positive) -> get_summary shows invocations=1, net_tokens_saved=-850, health=DEGRADED, recommendation='review or deprecate' (the EXISTING unmodified arithmetic, now fed real evidence) -> audit_portfolio correctly lists read-reuse under degraded_skills.
dogfood_evidence.lean_code_stale_rejection: A real P3.13 counterfactual_result exists for lean-code from this session's P3.13 closure, but is bound to a custom kernel-injection-treatment hash rather than lean-code's actual current SKILL.md content hash (24afb3198440996c3cf647d293b4d4bab4d21abf57ff2ab66424760e8d65233a) -- a genuine, naturally-occurring version mismatch, not a synthetic negative control. record_from_evidence correctly rejects it (measurement_state=unavailable, no ledger row, excluded from audit_portfolio) rather than silently treating version-A evidence as version-B evidence. No radar lineage or evaluation.json exists for lean-code either.
dogfood_evidence.idempotency_proof: record_from_evidence('read-reuse') called twice returns record_id=1 both times; get_summary still reports invocations=1 and net_tokens_saved=-850, not doubled.
dogfood_evidence.no_mutation_proof: git status confirms no change to skills/candidates/, skills/shadow/, skills/active/, or state/promotions/ beyond the pre-existing untracked read-reuse directory; read-reuse's lifecycle level is unchanged.
dogfood_evidence.bookkeeping_economics: Both compositions: model_calls=0, tool_calls=0, tokens=0, bookkeeping_wall_time_ms in the 1.7-4.8ms range -- pure local composition of already-persisted JSON plus one SQLite lookup/insert.

requirement_classification.evidence: MeasurementState enum (measured/estimated_only/unavailable) plus estimated_tokens_saved/measured_tokens_saved as distinct fields; 0 is stored/read only as a real measurement, never a placeholder for unknown; tested and dogfooded on real read-reuse data.

_estimated_benefit consumes P3.10 ImprovementRadar.get_candidate(); _measured_from_counterfactual_result consumes P3.13 counterfactual_result JSON; _measured_from_evaluation consumes P3.11 evaluation.json roi.net_tokens_saved; no token accounting is recomputed in gardener.py. Live-dogfooded against real repository evidence for both sources.

Every record binds skill_version via skillforge.lifecycle_content_hash; stale (version-mismatched) evidence rejected, proven both synthetically (test_record_from_evidence_rejects_stale_evaluation_version) and on the real lean-code case (a genuine version mismatch, not fabricated).

net_tokens_saved/roi_ratio/success_rate/SkillHealth thresholds and semantics are unchanged; get_summary now filters to measurement_state='measured' rows only, preserving the exact original arithmetic over legitimately measured data.

_classify_comparison produces estimate_optimistic/accurate/pessimistic, measured_negative, measured_approximately_zero, or inconclusive from real values; dogfooded live (read-reuse: measured_negative, estimation_error=-1450, not forced positive).

Existing state/skills/skill_roi.sqlite kept per the frozen plan's SQLite-for-ROI storage note, now made a derived evidence store with explicit *_evidence_ref/*_ref pointers back to canonical P3.10/P3.11/P3.13 evidence; no broad migration performed.

Real skills (read-reuse, lean-code) composed from real current repository evidence this session; zero new omp A/B campaign needed since existing P3.13 evidence discipline and P3.11/P3.10 evidence sufficed.

Four negative controls proven: missing measured tokens never fabricated as measured 0 (estimated_only path); missing estimate still allows a measured ROI (comparison=inconclusive only when measured itself is absent, not when estimate is absent and measured exists per test_record_from_evidence_composes_estimate_and_p3_11_measurement); estimate-exists-no-measurement stays estimated_only, never presented as measured (record_id=None, excluded from get_summary); stale/mismatched version evidence rejected (both synthetic and the real lean-code case). A legitimately measured zero remains valid 0 (test_record_from_evidence_measured_zero_is_valid_not_unavailable).

Not made a new mandatory P3.14 requirement (the frozen contract does not require it); P3.13's own fresh/cached token breakdown and cache-confound disclosure remain visible in its own persisted results and are not hidden or cache-normalized by P3.14's aggregation, which only consumes the already-computed total delta.
Zero calls into promotion.py; no auto-promotion or auto-retirement; confirmed by code inspection and live dogfood (no lifecycle/state mutation observed).
